{{Top|leg}}
'''Farsight Squadron''' was elite [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] formed during the reign of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. Farsight [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] utilized the [[RC-2 Twilight scoutship]]. Farsight Squadron's specialized role was reconnaissance. At the time of the [[Battle of Caamas]], the pilots of Farsight Squadron were on deployment across the galaxy tracking potential [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] targets.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
